_doc.comp: per feature type [a, b]: printed_actual - model = a + b*size (mm). hole = Ø of hole whose axis is vertical (Z), hole_h = Ø of horizontal-axis hole, shaft = Ø of pin/boss, outer = external linear size, inner = slot/pocket width. Model size is solved from this so the PRINTED part hits the target.
_doc.accuracy: [a, b] -> expected ± deviation after compensation = a + b*size (mm). Used to judge if a drawing tolerance is printable.
_doc.fits: target ACTUAL diametral clearance (hole - shaft, mm) per fit class; negative = interference.
_doc.xy_scale_pct: material shrink compensation applied to XY sizes. Keep 0 if the slicer already scales.
_doc.post_process_stock: material left on a hole/shaft (on Ø) when the tolerance needs drilling/reaming/sanding after printing.
_doc.note: Generic starting values. Print the calibration coupon (calibrate.py make) and run calibrate.py fit to replace them with values measured on YOUR printer; user profiles are saved to ~/.z3d-cad/print_profiles.json and override these.

fdm_pla.desc: FDM 0.4 mm nozzle, PLA, 0.2 mm layer (generic, uncalibrated)

fdm_petg.desc: FDM 0.4 mm nozzle, PETG, 0.2 mm layer (generic)

fdm_abs.desc: FDM 0.4 mm nozzle, ABS/ASA, 0.2 mm layer, enclosed (generic; ~0.5% shrink)

sls_pa12.desc: SLS nylon PA12, 0.1 mm layer (generic service-bureau values)

mjf_pa12.desc: HP MJF PA12, 0.08 mm layer (generic service-bureau values)
